newsitem.title: USA: DLJ adds DeRosa-Farag to junk bond research team.
newsitem.headline: DLJ adds DeRosa-Farag to junk bond research team.

text.p: Sam DeRosa-Farag, formerly the high-yield bond strategist at Chase Securities Inc, has joined Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Inc as a managing director and co-head of high-yield research.

In his new position at DLJ, DeRosa-Farag will be resposible for portfolio strategy and quantitative analysis. He will also be involved in the development of structured finance products including collateralized bond and loan obligations.
DeRosa-Farag will report directly to Bennett Goodman, managing director in charge of the high-yield bond and loan business at DLJ.
He will co-head the firm's research effort with Roger Gordon.
